name: devtool-answer-monitor
title: 在用户选择您的开发工具之前监控法学硕士的言论
description: Use when the user wants to monitor how ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and other LLMs describe a developer tool, API, SDK, or open-source project. DevTool Answer Monitor is the companion skill for the devtool-answer-monitor repo and covers query pool design, four-metric monitoring, model-specific content placement, content checks, negative-answer repair, activation analysis, and T+7 or T+14 regression validation.
title_en: Monitor What LLMs Say Before Users Choose Your Dev Tool
